title: A Hard NO on this one
body: Sorry, but antigravity itself is fantastic as a product. You should be paying ME to use the mobile app. It is a joke! It will not stay connected and it is largely worthless. What is needed is a full blown app that mirrors either the agent or explorer (or both) mode. I cancelled my subscription within a couple of days. If it were not a hassle to get my money back from Apple I would contest that as well.

title: Avoid pitfalls, can’t be used, don‘t subscribe
body: I don‘t know why there are so many good reviews, but it’s very difficult to use after I bought it, and I disconnect from time to time. The monthly fee is still so high. I‘m speechless.
